title: horizun.exchange/0 - the manifest of one cross-app hop
description: Written LAST, beside a copy of the payload, at <exchange_root>/<kind>/<exchange_id>/exchange.hzx.json. It wraps an existing format and never replaces it. A folder with payload and no manifest, or a manifest whose payload has not arrived, is 'not delivered'. verification.state 'verified' requires host_verified=true; anything else reads as self_reported_verified at best.

correlation_id.description: The orchestration run this hop belongs to; idempotency is correlation_id + hop + attempt.

model_evidence.description: The D0 evidence read from the model: creation_guid, central_guid, cloud_model_guid, unique_document_guid (strong, in that order), project_info_unique_id (weak, never matches alone), cloud_project_guid, revit_version, title, path.

path.description: A plain file name inside the exchange folder.

format.description: The wrapped format and its version, e.g. horizun.coordination-ledger.csv/2.

rows.description: Declared by the producer; reported, not re-counted, by the verifier.

caveats.description: What this file does NOT prove.
